subject: english
passage:
Mia: Do you know when the final bus _____ tonight?
Leo: I am not sure, but as soon as it _____, I will text you right away.
question: Which pair of verb forms best completes the conversation?
choices: will arrive; arrives
arrives; will arrive
will arrive; will arrive
arrived; arrives
explanation: 第一格 when 引導名詞子句作 know 的受詞（今晚最後一班公車何時會到），指未來事實用未來式 will arrive；第二格 as soon as 引導時間副詞子句，以現在簡單式 arrives 代替未來式。
hint1: 區分名詞子句（know 的受詞：何時）與時間副詞子句（as soon as：一……就……）。
hint2: 時間副詞子句用現在簡單式代未來，名詞子句則維持未來式。
alignmentBasis: https://cap.rcpet.edu.tw/；依116年會考題型方向與十二年國教第四學習階段能力設計，本站原創並核對唯一答案。

subject: english
passage: Before the science fair, Kevin noticed that the solar model _____ by his teammates needed a new battery. He quickly had the broken wire _____ before the judges walked into the hall.
question: Which choice best fills in the two blanks?
choices: built; fixed
building; fix
which built; to fix
was built; fixing
explanation: 第一格 the solar model (which was) built by his teammates 為過去分詞片語後位修飾（被隊友製作的模型）；第二格 had + 受詞 (the broken wire) + p.p. (fixed) 表使役被動（請人把斷線修好）。
hint1: 模型是「被製作」，電線是「被修理」。
hint2: 主要子句已有動詞 noticed，第一格需用分詞片語修飾 model。

subject: english
passage: For years, the old chemical plant at the edge of Green River sat empty. Last spring, the city council finally decided to address the long-ignored pollution problem by turning the site into a wetland park that filters rainwater naturally.
question: What does the word "address" mean in the passage?
choices: To deal with and solve a problem
To write a home location on an envelope
To give a formal graduation speech
To build a new factory near a river
explanation: 根據後文「將舊化學工廠（plant）改建為能自然過濾雨水的濕地公園」，可知 address the long-ignored pollution problem 意為「處理、解決長期被忽視的汙染問題」（熟詞僻義）。
hint1: 切勿直接選「地址」；看後面 by turning the site into a wetland park 的因果關係。
hint2: 此處的 plant 指「工廠」，address 指「處理、解決」。

subject: english
passage:
Four workshops are offered on Saturday:
• Coding Camp: 09:00–12:00 ($500, ages 13–16)
• Pottery Art: 10:30–13:00 ($350, all ages)
• Robot Lab: 13:30–16:00 ($600, ages 14+, 20% off for two people)
• Baking Fun: 14:00–16:30 ($400, ages 12+)
15-year-old Sam and his 15-year-old brother have $1,000 in total. They can only attend after 1:00 p.m. and want to take the same workshop together.
question: Which workshop can Sam and his brother both join within their total budget?
choices: Both Robot Lab and Baking Fun fit their schedule and budget
Only Baking Fun because Robot Lab costs $1,200 for two
Coding Camp because they are both 15 years old
Pottery Art because it is the cheapest option
explanation: Sam 與弟弟皆 15 歲、下午 1 點後才有空：Robot Lab 兩人原價 $1,200，但兩人同行打八折（20% off）為 $960 ≤ $1,000；Baking Fun 兩人 $800 ≤ $1,000，因此兩者皆符合時間、年齡與預算。
hint1: 注意 Robot Lab 括號內的「20% off for two people（兩人同行八折）」。
hint2: 篩選 13:00 之後開始且兩人總費用不超過 $1,000 的課程。
alignmentBasis: https://cap.rcpet.edu.tw/；依116年會考題型方向與十二年國教第四學習階段能力設計，本站原創並核對唯一答案。

subject: english
passage:
[Post A - Principal Lin] Starting next month, students will leave their smartphones in locked cabinets during class hours so they can focus on group discussions.
[Post B - Student Council] While we agree that phone notifications hurt focus, locking phones away all day prevents us from using dictionary apps in English class. We suggest allowing teacher-approved learning use instead.
question: What do Principal Lin and the Student Council agree on?
choices: Uncontrolled phone notifications can distract students during class
Smartphones should never be brought onto the school campus
Dictionary apps are useless for junior high school students
Students should keep their phones unlocked during every exam
explanation: Post A 希望減少手機分心，Post B 開頭也明確表示「While we agree that phone notifications hurt focus（雖然我們同意手機通知會損害專注力）」，兩者皆認同手機干擾課堂專注，僅對管理方式看法不同。
hint1: 找出 Post B 中表示「我們同意（we agree）」的句子。
hint2: 區分雙方「共識點」與「執行手段的差異」。
alignmentBasis: https://cap.rcpet.edu.tw/；依116年會考題型方向與十二年國教第四學習階段能力設計，本站原創並核對唯一答案。

subject: english
passage: When people think of deserts, they usually picture endless hot sand. However, Antarctica is actually the largest desert on Earth. Because a desert is defined by how little precipitation it receives—not by its temperature—this icy continent qualifies with less than 50 mm of snow each year.
question: What is the main idea of the passage?
choices: What defines a desert is low precipitation rather than high temperature
Hot sandstorms are becoming more common in Antarctica
Antarctica receives more rainfall than any other continent
Tourists should bring summer clothes when visiting all deserts
explanation: 首段以大眾刻板印象對比，用 However 轉折點出南極洲是最大沙漠，因為沙漠的定義取決於「降水量極少（how little precipitation it receives）」而非溫度。
hint1: 鎖定轉折詞 However 與 Because 後方的核心定義句。
hint2: 全文以南極洲為例說明沙漠的真正定義。
